title: Synchronization of coupled wind turbines
summary: In the context of renewable energies, wind energy appears as a sustainable alternative to address current environmental and energy challenges. This work studies the synchronization and stability of a network of wind turbines subjected to strong disturbances, by integrating a realistic modeling of wind variability by using the Ornstein-Uhlenbeck stochastic process. The dynamics of each wind turbine are described by a Kuramoto-type equation, while synchronization is analyzed through the time evolution of the phases.
